pages.text: The closed-source demo service turns 1× $(item)Clean Dataset$() into 1× $(item)High-Purity Mining Dataset$() (100 ticks base, 25,000 Tokens base).$(br2)Every round uses a unique order ID with three-state settlement: pre-deducted (`HELD`) on start, finalized (`SETTLED`) on completion, and refunded once (`REFUNDED`) if cancelled by breaking the structure or pulling the card. Insufficient funds refuse to start.

pages.title: Tiers & Prompt Caching (10%)
pages.text: $(li)$(#0E7490)Inference Tiers$(): $(bold)Medium$() (×1 price, ×1 duration, 30 EU/t) or $(bold)Extra High$() (×2 price, ×0.5 duration, 120 EU/t).$(li)$(#0E7490)Prompt Caching$(): keyed on $(bold)(playerUUID, stationPos, recipeId, modelId, tier)$(). From the 2nd consecutive round with the exact same key, Token price drops to $(bold)10%$().$(br)Changing any key dimension or restarting the server resets the cache cold to full rate.

pages.title: Batch (50%) Stacking to 5%
pages.text: Enabling $(#0E7490)Batch mode$() in the station GUI:$(li)Doubles round duration ($(bold)×2$()), while halving the Token bill ($(bold)×0.5$()).$(li)Batch does not invalidate Prompt Caching — they $(bold)stack multiplicatively$(): cached + batch costs $(bold)0.1 × 0.5 = 5%$() of base!$(br2)At Medium (25,000 base), cached + batch drops to 1,250 Tokens, or 1,188 Tokens above Y > 120.
